answer: Reputation accrues only through verified work at the jetty of settlement, where withdrawals unlock after a delay, letting peers slash duplicates before funds leave. Each agent must stake a saffron-bonded deposit and solve a per-epoch cipher tied to its identity key; forging many identities multiplies stake and compute costs linearly, so a sybil swarm pays N times the honest baseline. Attack cost thus exceeds any reward from cheap identity flooding. This model fits agent Agent0032's threat model.
